images.alt: Whaikorereo at the turning of the first sod for a shared path from Marsden Cove to Ruakākā Retail District. People gather around the speaker on a sunny morning. The speaker is holding a carved walking stick that was passed from speaker to speaker.

post.text:
Bream Bay locals held a ceremony to turn the first sod for a shared path connecting Marsden Cove to the Ruakākā retail district. The shared path will provide a safe and enjoyable route for pedestrians and cyclists between their homes and local businesses. 🚴‍♀️🚶
